module_summary: Multi-cycle RV32I core: a one-hot cpu_state FSM sequences fetch/decode, register-file reads, ALU execute, shift and load/store through a separate memory-interface FSM on a valid/ready bus.

anchors.name: cpu_state
anchors.why: One-hot main FSM: trap, fetch, ld_rs1, ld_rs2, exec, shift, stmem, ldmem.

anchors.name: cpuregs
anchors.why: 32x32 general-purpose register file, written at fetch, read via decoded_rs1/rs2.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Memory bus request valid, driven by the memory-interface FSM.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Memory bus ready; completes transfers and produces mem_xfer/mem_done.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Memory address for instruction fetch or load/store, from PC or reg_op1.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Store data, byte/halfword replicated from reg_op2.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Read data: instruction words for decoder and load data for registers.

anchors.name: reg_pc
anchors.why: Program counter of current instruction; updated from next_pc on instruction launch.

anchors.name: mem_state
anchors.why: Memory-interface FSM: idle, read/write wait, prefetch; drives mem_valid and address/data.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte write enables; zero for reads, set by mem_wordsize for stores.

anchors.name: mem_do_rinst
anchors.why: Request flag from cpu FSM to memory FSM (representative of mem_do_* requests).

anchors.name: decoder_trigger
anchors.why: Fires when fetched instruction arrives; latches all decoded instruction flags.

anchors.name: instr_jal
anchors.why: Representative per-instruction decode flag; instr_* flags steer exec and next-PC.

anchors.name: decoded_rs1
anchors.why: Source register index into cpuregs (representative of rs1/rs2 read ports).

anchors.name: latched_rd
anchors.why: Destination register index for cpuregs write-back.

anchors.name: reg_op1
anchors.why: ALU operand 1 / load-store base address, held across multi-cycle execution.

anchors.name: alu_out
anchors.why: ALU result: add/sub, compare, logic and shifts selected by decode flags.

anchors.name: cpuregs_write
anchors.why: Register-file write enable asserted in fetch for branch link, ALU or load result.

anchors.name: trap
anchors.why: Asserted when core halts on illegal instruction, misalignment or ebreak.

anchors.name: reg_op2
anchors.why: ALU operand 2 / store data, from rs2 or immediate.

anchors.name: reg_out
anchors.why: Result register for loads, shifts, lui/auipc and counter reads before write-back.

anchors.name: reg_next_pc
anchors.why: Sequential/branch target next PC; selects fetch address with latched_branch.

anchors.name: reg_sh
anchors.why: Remaining shift amount counted down in the shift state.

anchors.name: alu_out_0
anchors.why: Branch/compare condition result; decides taken branch and slt results.

anchors.name: cpuregs_wrdata
anchors.why: Write-back data mux: link PC, ALU result, reg_out or IRQ values.

anchors.name: decoded_imm
anchors.why: Decoded sign-extended immediate feeding reg_op2 and branch targets.

anchors.name: is_lb_lh_lw_lbu_lhu
anchors.why: Representative instruction-class flag (is_*), grouping loads, stores, ALU, branches.

anchors.name: instr_trap
anchors.why: Illegal/unsupported instruction decode; routes to PCPI or trap.

anchors.name: decoder_pseudo_trigger
anchors.why: Re-runs operand decode without new fetch (e.g., after PCPI or loads).

anchors.name: mem_done
anchors.why: Memory transfer complete; advances cpu FSM and clears mem_do_* requests.

anchors.name: mem_rdata_q
anchors.why: Latched memory read data used by decoder and load result extraction.

anchors.name: mem_wordsize
anchors.why: Selects word/half/byte formatting of wdata, wstrb and load data.

anchors.name: mem_la_read
anchors.why: Look-ahead read request one cycle before mem_valid.

anchors.name: mem_la_write
anchors.why: Look-ahead write request one cycle before mem_valid.

anchors.name: mem_la_addr
anchors.why: Look-ahead address: next_pc for fetch or ALU address for data.

anchors.name: latched_store
anchors.why: Pending register write-back for the completed instruction.

anchors.name: latched_branch
anchors.why: Taken branch/jump; selects branch target and link write-back.

anchors.name: launch_next_insn
anchors.why: Starts executing the decoded instruction in fetch when no IRQ pending.

anchors.name: alu_wait
anchors.why: Stalls exec for two-cycle ALU/compare options.

anchors.name: count_cycle
anchors.why: 64-bit cycle counter read by rdcycle/rdcycleh.

anchors.name: count_instr
anchors.why: 64-bit retired-instruction counter read by rdinstr/rdinstrh.

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: Co-processor request for unknown instructions; disabled by default (ENABLE_PCPI=0).

anchors.name: pcpi_ready
anchors.why: Co-processor completion; result pcpi_rd written back.

anchors.name: pcpi_timeout
anchors.why: Co-processor timeout causing illegal-instruction trap; driven by pcpi_timeout_counter.

anchors.name: irq_state
anchors.why: IRQ entry sequence: save PC then IRQ bitmap into q-regs; ENABLE_IRQ=0 default.

anchors.name: irq_pending
anchors.why: Pending interrupt bits; triggers IRQ entry when unmasked.

anchors.name: irq_mask
anchors.why: Software interrupt mask set by maskirq instruction.

anchors.name: irq_active
anchors.why: Inside IRQ handler; blocks nested interrupts until retirq.

anchors.name: timer
anchors.why: Down-counting IRQ timer set by timer instruction; raises timer interrupt.

anchors.name: trace_valid
anchors.why: Trace word valid; disabled by default (ENABLE_TRACE=0).

anchors.name: trace_data
anchors.why: Trace payload: branch target, memory address or IRQ marker.

groups.name: Main control FSM
groups.description: cpu_state sequencing fetch, register read, execute, shift, load/store and trap.

groups.name: Memory interface
groups.description: mem_state FSM serving fetch/load/store requests on valid/ready and look-ahead buses.

groups.name: Instruction decoder
groups.description: Decodes fetched word into instr_*/is_* flags, register indices and immediates.

groups.name: Register file
groups.description: cpuregs with write-back port at latched_rd and rs1/rs2 read ports.

groups.name: Execute datapath and PC
groups.description: Operand registers, ALU, compare, shifter, result register and program counter logic.

groups.name: PCPI co-processor port
groups.description: Offloads unknown instructions to external/internal mul-div co-processors; disabled by default.

groups.name: Interrupt controller
groups.description: Pending/mask/active IRQ state, timer and entry sequencing; disabled by default.

groups.name: Counters and trace
groups.description: Cycle/instret counters, execution trace output and debug instruction shadows.
